opening.text: I have HIV and have been taking zidovudine for the past three years. Forty-five days ago my HIV medicines were changed, and I started nevirapine together with zidovudine and lamivudine. The rash and the yellowing began about 20 days after I started nevirapine. I have a rash, a fever, and my skin itches. My skin and the whites of my eyes have turned yellow, and my urine has been dark. The rash, fever, muscle and joint aches, dark urine, itching and belly pain have been going on for 10 days.
